excluded_titles: CDC EID Rift Valley fever figure
process_order: S01 through S16, no substitution after retrieval

selection_rule.window: first 120000 characters of the frozen extraction
selection_rule.extraction: PDF: pdftotext -layout -enc UTF-8. HTML: strip script/style/noscript, then tags, unescape entities. Raw download bytes are the custody object.
selection_rule.sentence: split on whitespace following . ! or ?; keep spans of 80 to 700 characters
selection_rule.skip: navigation, cookie banners, table-of-contents lines, sentences whose main verb is shall/must/should, header-only dates, and comparisons inferred only by placing two unrelated numbers side by side
selection_rule.comparison: first remaining sentence that states a factual magnitude comparison between two named populations, periods, places, or groups
selection_rule.temporal: if no comparison sentence occurs first, the first remaining sentence that states a factual before/after order of two events
selection_rule.qualifiers: time, population, geography, and condition stay in the passage and in the concise claim
selection_rule.no_eligible: NO_ELIGIBLE_ACTIVE_FAMILY_CLAIM when the window has no such sentence, or when retrieval fails
selection_rule.claim_timing: concise ordinary-English claim and, where logically valid, one inverse or refuting paired claim are written before any CAL import
